note: A proposal the Owner may change or switch off; it is not in his database. The look was written from the studio's own headquarters picture (art-source/reference/headquarters_dusk_primary.png, described in docs/project/HQ_LIVING_OFFICE.md), the HQ manifest's rooms and the eight character bibles. style_block opens every shot prompt of every episode, word for word, so the serial is one look from shot to shot and from episode to episode; a character's face and clothes come from their bible, never from this file. The time of day is not fixed here: the Owner's rule is that the headquarters' sky follows the real conditions, never an eternal dusk. Change the words and bump the version: shots described under an older version are described again. With use_until_the_owner_changes_it false, serial shots carry no series look and the image model draws in its own default style.
style_block: Stylised cinematic 3D animation with a warm feature-film finish, adults at natural human proportions with expressive faces. The AMN-AI headquarters in Bucharest: warm wood, dark steel and glass, glowing monitors, bookshelves and potted plants. Warm lamp and screen light, soft shadows. Eye-level camera at human scale. Vertical 9:16 frame. No written words, letters or logos anywhere. Screens show abstract glow.
rendering: Stylised cinematic 3D animation with a warm feature-film finish, adults at natural human proportions with expressive faces.
palette: Warm amber lamp light and wood tones against cool blue glass and steel; each department keeps its own accent colour (Executive green, Research blue, Fact Check terracotta, Content wood, Distribution teal, Production violet).
continuity_rules: a character's face, hair, clothing and props are exactly as their character bible says, in every shot and every episode
every scene is inside the studio's own headquarters, in the room the beat names
one look for the whole series: the same rendering, materials and warm interior light
avoid: warped or extra hands and fingers
faces or clothes changing between shots
writing on walls, boards or screens

shot_sizes.establishing: Establishing wide shot at eye level, the whole room in view
shot_sizes.two_shot: Medium two-shot at eye level, both speakers facing the viewer
shot_sizes.single: Medium close-up single at eye level on {name}, facing the viewer
shot_sizes.close: Close-up at eye level on {name}'s reaction, facing the viewer
